slices.focus: Caleb organizes a corridor walk with before/after flood photos and resident testimony, turning visible progress into homeowner-to-homeowner trust
slices.summary: With survey stakes, drainage prep markings, and signed buyout packets visible in the corridor, Caleb organizes a walk where residents can see progress firsthand. Homeowners already in the buyout process talk to newer folks about why they stayed with the forms. The event shifts the dynamic from county-led persuasion to peer-based trust-building.
